title: Report a run resumed input
description: The runtime took up the answers and the run goes on. Refused while a decision request of the run is still Open: the run waits on every one of them.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
